We focus on serving teens and adults who desire a confident smile through custom, removable aligners, ensuring a comfortable and convenient treatment journey.

treatmentJourney.title: Consultation and 3D Scan
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a free consultation, where we perform a thorough evaluation and take a 3D iTero scan to precisely map your teeth and preview your new smile.

treatmentJourney.title: Custom Treatment Plan
treatmentJourney.description: Based on your 3D scan, a personalized treatment plan is crafted, outlining each stage of tooth movement. Your custom clear aligners are then manufactured specifically for you.

treatmentJourney.title: Aligner Delivery & Coaching
treatmentJourney.description: You'll receive your first set of clear aligners along with detailed instructions on how to wear them, care for them, and integrate them seamlessly into your daily routine.

treatmentJourney.title: Progress Check-Ins
treatmentJourney.description: Regular check-ins are scheduled every 6-10 weeks to monitor your progress, ensure your teeth are moving as planned, and provide you with your next sets of aligners.

treatmentJourney.title: Refinement Aligners
treatmentJourney.description: Towards the end of your treatment, refinement aligners may be provided to fine-tune your results, ensuring every tooth is perfectly aligned for your ideal smile.

treatmentJourney.title: Retention & Maintenance
treatmentJourney.description: Once your active treatment is complete, custom retainers are provided to maintain your beautiful new smile. We'll guide you on long-term care to keep your teeth perfectly straight.

faqItems.question: How long does Invisalign take versus traditional braces?
faqItems.answer: Clear aligner treatment duration varies by case, but it's often comparable to or sometimes shorter than traditional braces for mild to moderate corrections. We'll provide a personalized estimate during your free consultation.

faqItems.question: How much does Invisalign cost, and is it covered by insurance?
faqItems.answer: Clear aligners start at $188 per month with flexible payment plans. We accept most major insurance plans and will help you understand your benefits and costs upfront during your free exam.

faqItems.question: How many hours a day do I have to wear my aligners?
faqItems.answer: For optimal results, clear aligners should be worn 20-22 hours per day, removing them only for eating, drinking, brushing, and flossing. Consistency is key to a successful treatment.

faqItems.question: Can clear aligners fix my specific bite issue?
faqItems.answer: Clear aligners are effective for a wide range of orthodontic issues, from mild crowding to complex bite problems. Our free evaluation will determine if clear aligners are the right solution for your unique needs.

faqItems.question: Will clear aligners hurt or affect my speech?
faqItems.answer: You may experience some initial discomfort when starting new aligners, which quickly subsides. There might be a slight temporary adjustment to your speech, but most patients adapt quickly and speak normally.

faqItems.question: What happens after clear aligner treatment – do I need a retainer forever?
faqItems.answer: After achieving your desired smile with clear aligners, retention is crucial to maintain your results. We will provide custom retainers, and wearing them as instructed will help keep your teeth straight long-term.

doctor.name: Dr. Kishawn Kole-James
doctor.bio: Dr. Kishawn Kole-James has been providing dedicated orthodontic care in the Detroit area for over 8 years, driven by a commitment to making quality dental care accessible. He earned his Doctor of Dental Surgery from the University of Detroit Mercy School of Dentistry and further specialized, obtaining his Orthodontics Degree from Howard University in 2016. Before opening Superior Orthodontics, Dr. Kole-James served as Dental Director for three community health clinics in Detroit, focusing on community health. He enjoys spending time with his wife, Uchenna, and their two sons, Samuel and Emmanuel, when not in the office.
